thread:
Alex: Quick status check — delivery milestone is tomorrow EOD. Main open items: quant recs doc, batching/caching config, and the regression alerts. PRs in flight: #4523 (quant-grid), #4571 (kv-cache). Who can own final sign-off for quant?
Priya: I can take quant recs sign-off today. Need to confirm 4-bit vs 8-bit tradeoffs on gpt-medium. Ran a quick perf sweep — 4-bit yields ~1.2x throughput, ~0.7% decrease in ROUGE on our testset.
Marco: Re: batching, I sketched a config we can try in canary. Snippet: 
```
batching:
  max_batch_size: 64
  timeout_ms: 12
  enable_prefix_cache: true
  dynamic_batching: autoscale
```
Jen: Heads-up — regression alert fired on prod eval: prompt-set 'summarize-long' has 2 failing cases. Logs: https://ci.redwood/alerts/1745 (stacktrace + model diff attached)
sam-bot: Regression alert created (#1745) and assigned to @Jen and @Alex
Alex: @Priya can you confirm fallback plan? If we roll 4-bit by default, can we have automatic routing fallback to 8-bit when latency SLOs are breached?
Priya: Yes. Recommend policy: route->model-v2-4bit by default, fallback to model-v2-8bit when p95 > 120ms for 5m. I'll add the rollout config to the doc.
Marco: LGTM on the policy. I'll open a PR for the batching config and tag eng-runtime for canary deployment.
Li: Quick CR ping on #4571 — left comments about kv eviction strategy; eviction threshold currently at 512MB might be too low for long-contexts.
Jen: I'll triage the failing cases today and post a remediation plan by 3pm PST. If it's model-quality we may need a pin or revert.
Alex: Ok owners: Priya (quant recs + rollout policy), Marco (batching config + PR), Jen (regression triage), Li (kv-cache CR). If there are no blockers by 3pm we'll cut a release branch and schedule canary for tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Priya: On it — will update the quant doc and add comparative eval tables (4-bit vs 8-bit). Ping me if you need a quick decision earlier.
Marco: PR #4602 opened for batching configs, tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml for thumbs.
Li: CR updated after addressing eviction comments: https://github.com/redwood/optkit/pull/4571 — added comments and a small test for kv pressure.
Alex: Closing the loop — plan is canary at 10:00am PST tomorrow. If any last-minute blockers raise here I'll reassign.
Jen: Noted, will post a follow-up if triage finds model-level regressions.
Priya: Added fallback policy to docs and linked perf table.
Marco: Will monitor canary metrics and keep this thread updated.
Alex: Thanks all — feel free to @-mention in this thread for any urgent changes.
